body: Mars oxygen starts with heat and electricity: MOXIE split CO2 at about 800°C. This 2019 NASA/JPL lab demo predates MOXIE's Mars experiment, which ended in 2023 after producing 122 grams of oxygen. Footage courtesy NASA/JPL-Caltech.
